summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc, a Jersey-incorporated gold miner listed on NYSE American, AIM and VFEX, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a TR-1 major holdings notification (the US/UK equivalent of a Schedule 13G update) received from BlackRock, Inc. BlackRock crossed the AIM disclosure threshold on September 22, 2026, reporting 984,317 direct voting-rights shares (5.09%), 160,158 lent securities (0.82%) and 218,182 cash-settled CFDs (1.12%), for a combined 7.04% versus 7.01% previously. This is a routine passive-holder stake disclosure, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, price or deal terms are stated. Watch for any further accumulation toward an activist position.
